warnings: primary logo has several colours. Plain single-colour versions merge overlapping shapes; knockout versions turn enclosed shapes in ['#f36c5c', '#fefeff', '#9ec8e7'] into holes instead. Inspect both, keep the one that preserves the logo's detail, and ask the designer for official single-colour artwork if neither does.
